source._comment: LIVE. Ohio SoS 'Absentee and Early Voting Data' dashboard (data.ohiosos.gov/portal/election-dashboards -> Power BI publish-to-web). The portal page and the SoS text export (publicfiles.ohiosos.gov) sit behind a Cloudflare browser challenge, but the report's public query API does not, so oh_update.py queries it directly (same aggregates the dashboard shows). Ohio has no party registration; Voter_Party_Bucketed is the SoS's voter-affiliated party from partisan-primary history: Republican->rep, Democratic->dem, Unaffiliated->npa, Minor Party + blank->oth. NO_EIP = absentee by mail, INCL_EIP = mail + early in person. The report's locked page filters (Election Ballot Return Date Range, VALID_DATE_BOOL_AGG = true) must be applied or sums double count. Refreshes daily ~noon ET; polled only after refresh_after_utc_hour until the day's stamp lands. Switch election_description if the SoS relabels the election.
